{"number":1756,"title":"Judge a beating agent on its progress, not its punctuality","body":"**Stacked on [#1753](https://github.com/missingbulb/Claudinite/pull/1753)** — it needs that branch's `agentBeatComment`, so it bases there rather than on `main`. Merging #1753 first re-targets this one automatically.

#1753 gives the agent phase a beat, and creates the hazard this closes: a beat resets the issue clock by existing, so the clock alone makes every beating session **immortal** — including one that wedged an hour in. The signal degrades from "work is happening" to "a process is alive", which is the failure the leash exists to catch.

The beat already carries what separates them: its note is the progress (`9/15 groups triaged`), so a run of beats all saying the same thing is a wedged run, however punctual.

**`packs/claudinite-tasks/queue/`** — `lastProgressAt` answers when the beat note last *changed* (the oldest beat of the trailing run sharing the newest one's note), reading the note back off the rendered comment body since that is the only copy. Rule B (`deadAgentItems`) takes a `progressAt` reader the way `staleReadyItems` takes `periodFor` — injected, so the rule stays pure and the sweep keeps the I/O — and runs its leash from progress when the item has beats, from the issue clock when it has none. `deadAgentComment` says which of the two it was, so a reader knows whether to look for a dead session or a stuck one.

**`packs/claudinite-tasks/tasks/task-janitor/`** — the sweep resolves progress only for items actually holding an agent (usually none or one), and hands the rule a finished lookup.

**Rollout is inert until sessions beat.** An item with no beats answers `null` and is judged exactly as today — which is every item on the fleet right now, since nothing beats until #1753's `executor.md` reaches members. No behaviour change lands ahead of the writer.

See-it-fail, three mutations, each biting only its own guard:

| mutation | red |
|---|---|
| rule B back on the issue clock | both leash cases (the stale-clock/live-work and live-clock/dead-work pair) |
| progress = newest beat, not last change | the `lastProgressAt` case |
| no-beats answers a time instead of `null` | the `lastProgressAt` case |

661 tests pass across `claudinite-tasks`; `check_the_world` 0 blocking. The one new advisory is a fifth `file-placement` reach from `queue-sweep.mjs` into `queue/`, identical to the four already there — that file is the I/O shell over `queue/`, the deliberate cross-cutting concern the check's own fix text says to leave.

Closes #1752
